Disonasu also praised Naruto about defeating Pain, the one who scarred him and left him powerless, before kicking the boy repeatedly.
Miina and the orphans came to The Hole to give the iron bars, but Kabuto's clone intercepted them.

outro.fallback: When the storm expands towards Konoha, Tsunade goes out as the storm engulfs the Land of Fire.
Naruto tried to stop Disonasu from ascending the tower, only to face his clone after he absorbed some of the tower's power and transformed into a Hydra-tailed fox monster.
